cues.en: Seriously though, we've heard a lot about extremism recently, a nastier, harsher atmosphere everywhere, more abuse and bother-boy behavior, less friendliness and tolerance and respect for opponents. All right, but what we never hear about extremism is its advantages. Well, the biggest advantage of extremism is that it makes you feel good because it provides you with enemies. They've explained.
cues.zh: 说正经的，最近我们听到太多关于极端主义的讨论，到处是更恶劣、更严酷的氛围，更多的辱骂和烦人行为，更少的友善、宽容和对对手的尊重。好吧，但我们从来没听过极端主义的优点。嗯，极端主义最大的优点就是让你感觉良好，因为它给你提供了敌人。他们解释过了。

cues.en: The great thing about having enemies is that you can pretend that all the badness in the whole world is in your enemies, and all the goodness in the whole world is in you. Attractive, isn't it? So, if you have a lot of anger and resentment in you anyway, and you therefore enjoy abusing people, then you can pretend that you're only doing it because these enemies of yours are such very bad persons. And that if it wasn't for them, you'd actually be good natured and courteous and rational all the time.
cues.zh: 有敌人的妙处在于，你可以假装世界上所有的坏都在你的敌人身上，所有的好都在你身上。很吸引人，对吧？所以，如果你本来就满腔怒火和怨恨，因此乐于辱骂他人，那你可以假装你这么做只是因为你的这些敌人太坏了。而且要不是因为他们，你其实会一直和善、有礼、理性。

cues.en: So if you want to feel good become an extremist, okay Now you have a choice if you join the hard left They'll give you their list of authorized enemies almost all kinds of authority, especially the police the city Americans judges multinational corporations public schools furriers newspaper owners Fox hunters generals class traitors and of course moderates
cues.zh: 所以如果你想感觉良好，就当个极端主义者吧，好。现在你有得选，如果你加入强硬左派，他们会给你他们那份授权敌人名单——几乎各种权威，尤其是警察、城市、美国人、法官、跨国公司、公立学校、皮草商、报社老板、猎狐者、将军、阶级叛徒，当然还有温和派。

cues.en: Or, if you'd rather be an extremist on the hard right, no problem, fine, you still get a lovely list of enemies, only they're different ones. Noisy minority groups, unions, Russia, weirdos, demonstrators, welfare sponges, meddlesome clergy, peace nicks, the BBC, strikers, social workers, communists, and of course, moderates. And upstart actors. Now, once you're armed with one of these super lists of enemies,
cues.zh: 或者，如果你更愿意当强硬右翼的极端主义者，没问题，行，你照样能得到一份可爱的敌人名单，只是不一样罢了。吵闹的少数群体、工会、俄罗斯、怪人、示威者、吃福利的寄生虫、爱管闲事的教士、和平主义者、BBC、罢工者、社工、共产主义者，当然还有温和派。还有暴发户演员。现在，一旦你手握这些超级敌人名单之一，

cues.en: You can be as nasty as you like and yet feel your behaviors morally justified. So you can strut around abusing people and telling them you could eat them for breakfast and still think of yourself as a champion of the truth, a fighter for the greater good and not the rather sad paranoid schizoid that you really are.
cues.zh: 你就可以想多恶毒就多恶毒，却仍觉得自己的行为在道德上正当。于是你可以趾高气扬地辱骂别人，告诉他们你能把他们当早餐吃掉，却仍然自视为真理的捍卫者、为更大利益而战的斗士，而不是你实际上那个相当可悲的偏执精神分裂者。
